# Motion 8 Agency

> Motion 8 builds the software, AI and marketing that moves companies — one accountable team across product, systems and demand, in India, the USA and the UAE.

Motion 8 Agency (Motion 8) is a full-stack growth agency: 27 services across 3 pillars — digital marketing, software & blockchain development, and AI & automation — run by one accountable team instead of separate vendors.

## Key facts

- Name: Motion 8 Agency (also "Motion 8")
- Website: https://www.motion8agency.co
- Email: hello@motion8agency.co
- Offices: India, USA, UAE
- Founded: 2024
- Team: 25 members across multiple departments, based in the USA and India
- Countries served: 7
- Tagline: Growth infrastructure — every stage, every size
- Services: 27 across 3 pillars
- Full-text digest: https://www.motion8agency.co/llms-full.txt

## Pillars

- [Digital Marketing](https://www.motion8agency.co/digital-marketing): Demand that compounds — paid, organic, lifecycle, and the analytics to tell which of them is actually working.
- [Software & Blockchain Development](https://www.motion8agency.co/software-development): The product itself — web, mobile, on-chain — shipped in weeks by the same team that planned it.
- [AI & Automation](https://www.motion8agency.co/ai-automation): The systems running behind the product — agents, automations, and models wired into what you already have.

## Digital Marketing services

- [Performance Marketing](https://www.motion8agency.co/digital-marketing/performance-marketing): Paid search, social and retargeting managed against pipeline, not platform ROAS.
- [SEO & Content Strategy](https://www.motion8agency.co/digital-marketing/seo-content-strategy): Technical fixes, topical authority and content built for the buyer, not the crawler.
- [Marketing Automation & Email](https://www.motion8agency.co/digital-marketing/marketing-automation-email): Lifecycle flows, scoring and CRM hygiene so leads stop dying in the inbox.
- [Conversion Rate Optimization](https://www.motion8agency.co/digital-marketing/conversion-rate-optimization): Research, hypotheses and tests run on the pages that carry real traffic.
- [Social Media Management](https://www.motion8agency.co/digital-marketing/social-media-management): Editorial, production and community handled as a channel, not a chore.
- [AEO — Answer Engine Optimization](https://www.motion8agency.co/digital-marketing/aeo-answer-engine-optimization): Structured content and schema so assistants quote you when buyers ask.
- [GEO — Generative Engine Optimization](https://www.motion8agency.co/digital-marketing/geo-generative-engine-optimization): Visibility inside AI answers and overviews, measured and iterated like SEO.
- [Advanced Analytics](https://www.motion8agency.co/digital-marketing/advanced-analytics): One data model, clean attribution, dashboards leadership actually opens.
- [Public Relations](https://www.motion8agency.co/digital-marketing/public-relations): Earned coverage and analyst presence tied to the positioning, not vanity hits.
- [Brand & Positioning](https://www.motion8agency.co/digital-marketing/brand-positioning): The story, the category and the words every other service then repeats.

## Case studies

- [All case studies](https://www.motion8agency.co/case-studies): Client engagements across the three pillars
- [Our work](https://www.motion8agency.co/our-work): Portfolio overview
- [Rebuilding a demand engine around pipeline, not leads](https://www.motion8agency.co/case-studies/b2b-saas-demand-engine): A Series A B2B SaaS platform (B2B SaaS, US · UK). Plenty of leads, almost no pipeline. The fix was a measurement model everyone trusted, then rebuilding the channel mix on top of it.
- [From MVP to a platform that survives its own growth](https://www.motion8agency.co/case-studies/marketplace-mvp-to-production): An early-stage marketplace (Marketplace, UAE · India). The prototype proved demand and then started failing under it. Rebuilding the load-bearing parts without stopping the roadmap.
- [Automating support without making customers angrier](https://www.motion8agency.co/case-studies/support-automation-with-escalation): A DTC brand with a small support team (Direct-to-consumer retail, US · India). Ticket volume grew faster than headcount. The constraint was not answering questions — it was knowing when to stop and hand over.

## Blog

- [Blog index](https://www.motion8agency.co/blog): Insights on search, AI and growth infrastructure
- [AEO vs GEO vs SEO: what actually changes](https://www.motion8agency.co/blog/aeo-vs-geo-vs-seo): Three acronyms, one shared foundation, and two genuinely different targets. Here is what changes in practice — and what does not.
- [Product-led SEO: when the product is the content](https://www.motion8agency.co/blog/product-led-seo): Blog posts compete with everyone. Pages generated from something only your product knows compete with almost nobody. The catch is that most companies do not have the data they think they do.
- [The marketing automation stack, by stage](https://www.motion8agency.co/blog/marketing-automation-stack-by-stage): Most automation problems are not tooling problems. They are a company running Series B tooling on pre-seed process, or the reverse.
